title: Observability and Semiclassical Control for Schrödinger Equations on Non-compact Hyperbolic Surfaces
summary: We study the observability of the Schrödinger equation on $X$, a non-compact covering space of a compact hyperbolic surface $M$. Using a generalized Bloch theory, functions on $X$ are identified as sections of flat Hilbert bundles over $M$. We develop a semiclassical analysis framework for such bundles and generalize the result of semiclassical control estimates in [Dyatlov and Jin, Acta Math., 220 (2018), pp. 297-339] to all flat Hilbert bundles over $M$, with uniform constants with respect to the choice of bundle.
